name: breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Breadcrumb: lettering, links whose underline thickens on hover, the current page as an ink flat, brush chevrons between steps.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/breadcrumb". It wraps your own components/ui/breadcrumb, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: Lettering, brush chevrons, the current page in ink.
meta.usage:
import { Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, BreadcrumbList, BreadcrumbPage, BreadcrumbSeparator } from "@/components/ui/manga/breadcrumb"

<Breadcrumb>
  <BreadcrumbList>
    <BreadcrumbItem><BreadcrumbLink href="#">Library</BreadcrumbLink></BreadcrumbItem>
    <BreadcrumbSeparator />
    <BreadcrumbItem><BreadcrumbPage>Vol. 3</BreadcrumbPage></BreadcrumbItem>
  </BreadcrumbList>
</Breadcrumb>
